paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
notes: Lattice QCD calculation of topological susceptibility constraining the axion decay constant f_a vs oscillation temperature T_osc. Main result: f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV if QCD axions are all of dark matter. The exclusion plot (Fig. 6) is in the T_osc-f_a plane, not a coupling vs mass plane, so numerical (mass_eV, coupling) pairs cannot be extracted in the standard AxionMass format. Only a single bound f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV is given in text. No tabulated mass-coupling data available.
